notes.models: Per-role chains chosen on 2026-10-14 by: available on this account AND benchmark-backed AND output < $1/Mtok. Benchmarks: CritPt (scientific), SciCode + Terminal-Bench 4.0 (coding/agentic), GPQA (reasoning/analysis), HLE (planning), LCR (long context), MMMU-Pro (vision). Scores from artificialanalysis.ai model payload; Terminal-Bench from tbench.ai leaderboard. Exception: visual keeps deepseek-v4.1-flash ($1.20 out, MMMU-Pro 77.0) - no vision model under $1 has a published score. qwen is excluded by user preference.
notes.tiers: Two tiers by the user's rule: QUALITY roles (planner, reviewer, verifier, security, profiling, scientific research) run mimo-v2.6-pro / glm-5.3-flash; SPEED roles (implementer, documentator, cicd, infrastructure, visual, web lookups) run deepseek-v4.1-flash (~70 tps measured vs ~33/30). Batch ':batch' model ids are NOT usable: they 404 on /chat/completions (DeepInfraBatchAdapter) and are excluded from the cache.
